Os juros futuros recuam em toda a curva, em especial na ponta longa. Nos Treasuries, os rendimentos voltaram a subir. NY tem alta moderada em meio a avaliações sobre a intervenção do Tesouro americano e o plano fiscal prometido pelo secretário Scott Bessent. Dow Jones sobe +0,67%; o S&P 500 +0,36% e o Nasdaq +0,21%.*(Ana Katia)*

queue.title: Why Small-Cap ETFs Could Break Out
queue.resumo: Bridgeway Capital CEO John Montgomery joins Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about why small-cap value ETFs could be poised for a comeback after years of large-cap dominance. He breaks down the advantage active ETFs can have in less-liquid stocks, why valuations look compelling, and why AI still isn’t a guaranteed source of investing alpha. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: America’s Critical Minerals Problem
queue.resumo: Critical Metals CEO and Executive Chairman Tony Sage joins Bloomberg Open Interest to warn the US is still years away from breaking China’s grip on key rare-earth metals, with processing capacity emerging as the biggest hurdle. He explains the geopolitical risk of that delay and pushes back on concerns surrounding its Greenland project, saying production remains on track for 2029. (Source: Bloomberg)
